whatItIsFor: National emergency number (ERSS). Requests ambulance support and identifies the nearest hospital designated under the cashless scheme.
whenToUse: Any emergency. Call this first if you are unsure which number to use.
When you need an ambulance and 112 is busy or unresponsive.

whatItIsFor: National Health Authority helpline, for grievances about the cashless treatment scheme.
whenToUse: If a hospital refuses cashless treatment or there is a problem with a claim under the 2025 scheme.
